From the owner
Planning Ahead Prevents Costly Surprises When homeowners imagine a remodeling project, they usually picture the finished result—a beautiful kitchen, an updated bathroom, or a more functional living space. What they don't see is the planning that makes those results possible. At Allegiant Renewal and Construction Services, we believe every successful renovation starts with a solid plan. Careful preparation helps minimize delays, control costs, and reduce unexpected challenges before construction begins. Our planning process focuses on: ✅ Accurate budgeting ✅ Realistic timelines ✅ Identifying potential issues early ✅ Permit and code compliance ✅ Material and schedule coordination ✅ Clear project roadmaps By addressing these details upfront, we help create a smoother experience from start to finish. Thoughtful planning also provides better budget control. While surprises can happen in any renovation, a well-prepared project significantly reduces costly setbacks and allows homeowners to make informed decisions with confidence. Whether you're considering a kitchen remodel, bathroom renovation, basement finishing project, or a complete home update, investing time in planning is one of the smartest decisions you can make. A wood-finish Shaker vanity, veined white countertop, linen tower, and hexagon bathroom floor tile complete the space. From the owner
An older home in a good Boise neighborhood can beat new construction, but price it honestly first. Homes built before 1978 fall under the EPA's lead-safe renovation rule, which raises the cost of even minor remodeling. Aluminum branch wiring turns up in houses built between roughly 1965 and 1973. Cast iron and clay sewer laterals are common in older neighborhoods, and a sewer scope costs a fraction of a line replacement. Take the inspection report, price every deferred item at current labor rates, then compare. Element Restoration assesses structure and systems before you write an offer.
